title: Revision directs meanings towards harmony
meaning: Rebuilding an unstable foundation can sustain your inquiry’s direction and bring harmony between different aspects of the experience considered together.
text: Different meanings sometimes come into accord after a simple measure is lost. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly rebuilding a conclusion’s unstable foundation. The Chariot in energy supports sustaining shared inquiry’s direction. Temperance in emotions feels harmony between aspects. Releasing an answer that previously ordered impressions can be difficult. Wanting a particular question understood preserves relationships between observations while the earlier structure no longer helps.

Suppose you explained a city location’s comfort solely through an absence of people. Comparing a lively square where both feel comfortable, you release that foundation. **Revision can direct different observations towards understandable harmony.** Focused attention considers movement, distances and opportunities to pause. Quiet gains its place among other conditions. Harmony concerns relationships between parts. You can distinguish a crowd obscuring what is visible from noticeable city life leaving room for personal attention. Your view retains a concrete subject while each person may name an individual reason for feeling comfortable there.

The risk is harmonising examples too quickly to feel that direction has been found. Wanting inquiry preserves distinctions. This square showed one measure’s insufficiency while another instance still needs consideration. Your view deepens when direction helps notice material, allowing harmony to arise from actual relationships without making every example confirm an already pleasing shared structure.
